يعتمرا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَمِرَا (yaʕtamirā) /jaʕ.ta.mi.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# يُعْتَمَرَا (yuʕtamarā) /juʕ.ta.ma.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
